dedicated.name: Dongyoung's Black Shadow Hat

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Dongyoung by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
Mocking the vengeful spirits as they writhed and cursed him, Dongyoung seized their shadows one by one and bent them to his will. Then, he wove together the tormented souls to craft a gat —a traditional hat— to conceal his face.
"Go on, try harder. The deeper your resentment runs, the darker my shadow will become."

lore:
Five hundred years ago, Dongyoung was an official who governed a province of Shinji.
He was a cold-blooded man who reveled in the suffering of others, and he had no qualms about exploiting his people to build his own golden walls.
Yet his arrogance, born from the belief that his power would last forever, was brought to a futile end by the blade of an unnamed warrior passing through the village.
But death did not grant him rest.
The countless vengeful spirits of those he had sacrificed, wronged souls who wandered the nine heavens, were drawn to him by the scent of blood.
Screaming in fury, the spirits tore apart Dongyoung's corpse and clung to him, consuming him whole.
Their resentment dragged Dongyoung back from the boundary of death, and he was reborn as a monster from the abyss.
